topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer opens the session by welcoming the class and outlining the scope of the lecture on inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen Recognition and PRR Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses microbial presence and tissue damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory Response and Leukocyte Recruitment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how sentinel cell activation directs the mobilization and trafficking of immune cells during an inflammatory response and the risks of excessive systemic activation.

topics.label: Inflammation Resolution, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the mechanisms required to terminate inflammatory responses and heal tissue, along with the chronic outcomes that arise when inflammation cannot be fully resolved.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the subject of the upcoming lecture.
